maps.name: Neon Rooftops
maps.description: A rooftop playground high above a neon city. Low alleys, high bridges, and a central water tower.

maps.name: Pulse Arena
maps.description: An indoor chase-tag stadium. A dense obstacle quad in the middle, catwalks above, wall-jump chimneys.

maps.name: Sunset Dockyard
maps.description: A container port at golden hour. Stack-hop the containers, cut through the warehouse, ride the cargo launchers.

maps.name: Training Ground
maps.description: A clean practice facility with a labelled station for every movement skill.

maps.name: Overgrown Mall
maps.description: A huge abandoned three-storey mall reclaimed by plants. Ride the escalators, cross the sky bridge, drop into the fountain.

maps.name: Splash Kingdom
maps.description: A sunny mega waterpark. Climb the spiral towers, ride the slides into the pools, weave through the loungers.

maps.name: Toy Factory
maps.description: A giant toy factory. Ride the conveyor belts, climb the toy blocks, run the catwalks and take the chute into the ball pit.
